# Kishu

> Kishu coordinates AI coding workflows in Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code. Customize model roles, add design guidance, and get clear, checked results.

Kishu is an open-source plugin for existing coding agents. Kishu mode coordinates work; it does not run visitor prompts on this website. Model choices depend on the host. Cost and time savings are task dependent, and the walkthroughs are illustrative.

## Product and setup

- [Product overview and common questions](https://spduk.github.io/kishu-stack/index.md): workflow, model roles, installation commands, limitations, and attribution.
- [Source and full installation guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SPDUK/kishu-stack/main/README.md): authoritative repository documentation.

- [Site build story](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SPDUK/kishu-stack/main/site/BUILD_STORY.md): the site as a real Kishu project.

- [Third-party notices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SPDUK/kishu-stack/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): upstream authors and licenses.
